name: PixiJS Filters
role: Community filter pack for PixiJS: glow, bloom, shockwave, CRT and more
summary: Collection of community-authored display filters for PixiJS such as glow, bloom, shockwave, pixelate, CRT, RGB split and displacement. Applied by assigning to a container or sprite's filters array and animating uniforms from time. Output is a PixiJS canvas. Distinguishing strength: ready-made 2D effects without writing GLSL.
use_when: Over writing GLSL when a PixiJS scene needs glow, CRT, shockwave or glitch effects
Per-object animated effects where CSS filters are too coarse
Seekable 2D FX where uniforms are set as a function of t
avoid_when: No PixiJS in the scene: glfx-js or gl-react for image effects
Mismatched pixi.js major: pin pixi-filters to the matching major
notes: 2026-10-26: package name is pixi-filters while the repo is pixijs/filters; compatibility with the current pixi.js major was not verified.

assessment.rationale: npm release Nov 2025, repo pushed Feb 2026; MIT. Wide ready-made effect catalogue beside PixiJS core filters.
